decision: Retain bundled semantic light v2. Trial 22 reduces several extras and learns training portals, but misses the held-out portal and regresses stone/Astral recall. Keep both checkpoints locally as research evidence.

preprediction_review.annotation_phase: Images visually reviewed and labels frozen before any model prediction on the ten new images. No test results used for selection.

planned_trial.selection: highest validation F0.5 at fixed threshold .35; earliest tie; test only after selection

recipe.method: frozen segmentation with physical light centers

context_probe.purpose: Diagnostic on training and validation portals only; no checkpoint or runtime tile selection.

limits: Only one cool validation portal; no claim of broad style generalization.
New test layouts were first evaluated only after selecting step 2850 at threshold 0.35. They are now observed tests.
Training, validation, procedural tests, previously observed diagnostics, and first-use artist test layouts must be reported separately.
Partial masks exclude unreviewed pixels and character sprites; all-map precision is unknown on those maps.
An extra is an unmatched point: it can be a displaced or duplicate point on a real emitter, not necessarily a nonexistent light.
No runtime tile size, bundled model, palette fallback, wall, door, or transparent export behavior changed.
No live Foundry import, other GPU/OS, or release package was tested in this data/training change.
Training runtime is not a controlled speed benchmark; CPU tests ran during part of training.
